scope: Entropy, surprisal, novelty, compression, algorithmic complexity, predictive information, and procedural emergence in music

records.title: Auditory Expectation: The Information Dynamics of Music Perception and Cognition
records.claim: Entropy and event information content represent different aspects of musical expectation.
limits: Theory and review, not a Suno study

records.title: Predictive uncertainty in auditory sequence processing
records.claim: Listeners experience greater uncertainty in high-entropy melodic contexts; expertise relates to more accurate probabilistic expectations.

records.title: Predictability and Uncertainty in the Pleasure of Music: A Reward for Learning?
records.claim: Tests relationships between entropy, information content, and pleasure; evidence does not justify a simple universal inverted-U rule.

records.title: Information dynamics: patterns of expectation and surprise in the perception of music
records.claim: Time-varying information measures can characterize unfolding musical structure.
limits: Uses simplified probabilistic models and selected examples

records.title: Predictability and the pleasure of music
records.claim: A balance of surprise and predictability is implicated in preference, with individual differences.
limits: Specific study design and listener population

records.title: An investigation of music analysis by the application of grammar-based compressors
records.claim: Grammar-based compression can recover useful musical structure, but overlapping and varied patterns can challenge exact grammars.

records.title: Grammar-based compression and its use in symbolic music analysis
records.claim: Grammar compression can identify hierarchical patterns and distinguish some styles and composers in evaluated symbolic datasets.

records.title: The Interconnections of Music Structure, Harmony, Melody, Rhythm, and Predictivity
records.claim: Hierarchical repetition structures interact with harmony, melody, rhythm, and predictivity.
limits: MIDI/pop dataset and chosen structural representation

records.title: Minimum description length modelling of musical structure
records.claim: MDL can select quantitative models of musical structure from statistically extracted patterns.
limits: Model family determines what counts as a good description

records.title: Computational Creativity and Aesthetics with Algorithmic Information Theory
records.claim: Algorithmic information theory offers a framework for relating compact generative descriptions to creative processes.
limits: Theoretical framework; algorithmic complexity is not artistic value

records.title: Information-Theoretic Measures Predict the Human Judgment of Rhythm Complexity
records.claim: Entropy rate and Kolmogorov complexity relate to human judgments of rhythmic complexity and ease.
limits: Artificial rhythmic sequences and limited sample

records.title: Structures in Sound: Analysis of Classical Music Using the Information Length
records.claim: Musical evolution can be analyzed as movement through statistical states using information geometry.

records.title: Information content of note transitions in the music of J. S. Bach
records.claim: Note-transition networks offer a framework for quantifying information in Bach's music.

records.title: Quantifying the evolution of harmony and novelty in western classical music
records.claim: A directed KL divergence rate can quantify departure from a historical transition model while distinguishing novelty from internal sequential dependence.
limits: Western classical corpus and chosen historical model

records.title: Computational Creativity and Music Generation Systems: An Introduction to the State of the Art
records.claim: Algorithmic composition spans multiple procedural families with different control and emergence properties.

records.title: Rules, Probability, and Emergence: A Comparative Study of Traditional Algorithmic Composition Approaches
records.claim: Compares rule-based, optimization, complex-systems, and statistical approaches to algorithmic composition.

records.title: Recent advances in music generation: methods, evaluation, and challenges
records.claim: Music generation evaluation needs distinct measures for quality, diversity, alignment, and controllability.
limits: Survey synthesis; industrial systems not exhaustively covered

records.title: JAM: A Tiny Flow-based Song Generator with Fine-grained Controllability and Aesthetic Alignment
records.claim: Fine-grained word timing control and preference alignment can be addressed as distinct parts of song generation.
limits: Specific open model and task; not Suno research

evidence_policy: Do not equate entropy, surprisal, novelty, compression, complexity, or aesthetic value. State the representation and reference model for any quantitative claim. No inference about Suno internals.
